test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is NOT a use of baking soda?

(i) to make drinking water free from germs

(ii) in soda-acid fire extinguishers

(iii) an ingredient in antacids
solution:
The correct answer is __**only i.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Baking soda** is** not** used to make drinking water free from germs.
 
• It is used to **treat water **that is too acidic and to remove **odors and stains.**
 
• Baking soda is used in soda-acid fire
